message.reasoning_content:
The claim: "The meta-analysis concluded that the best spacing interval is the same no matter how long the information must be retained."

Passage [3] says: "the ISI producing maximal retention increased as retention interval increased." This directly contradicts the claim — the optimal spacing interval varies with retention interval, it is NOT the same. So the claim is contradicted by the source.

Verdict: not_supported, passage 3.
